global_rule: Every enabled sport is evaluated independently; the global state is the worst sport state.
fail_closed_rules: Unknown event identity is BLOCKED, never silently dropped.
Any input timestamp after decision_time_utc is a lookahead violation.
NOT_APPLICABLE is valid only for a named gate or a zero-game date and cannot erase another blocker.
SHADOW_ONLY never becomes HEALTHY by inheritance.
A release manifest is an audit artifact and does not authorize wagers.
